gloss: actor known for acting skill; character actor

definitions.explanation: An actor whose reputation rests on the quality of the performance rather than on looks or star appeal. Standard praise in Japanese entertainment coverage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{演技派|えんぎは}だ。
examples.english: She is a genuinely skilled actor.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{演技派|えんぎは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しか⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Only an actor of real skill can play this role.

examples.japanese: ⟦アイドル→アイドル：05111_aidoru⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦デビュー→デビュー：11016_debyuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{地道|じみち}→地道：15599_jimichi⟧な⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{演技派|えんぎは}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{転身|てんしん}→転身：14395_tenshin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After debuting as an idol, she made a steady effort and reinvented herself as a serious actor.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{演技|えんぎ}→演技：01890_engi⟧ (acting) plus 〜⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧ (type, school). Used as a noun ({演技派|えんぎは}だ) and attributively with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {演技派|えんぎは}⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧: an actor known for skill
- {演技派|えんぎは}⟦{女優|じょゆう}→女優：03353_joyuu⟧: an actress known for skill
- {演技派|えんぎは}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧: to be known as a fine actor
- {演技派|えんぎは}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転身|てんしん}→転身：14395_tenshin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to reinvent oneself as a serious actor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{実力派|じつりょくは}→実力派：30320_jitsuryokuha⟧: genuinely talented performer — broader, covers singers and musicians too
- ⟦{個性派|こせいは}→個性派：30340_koseiha⟧: a performer with a distinctive presence — praises uniqueness, not technique
